name: Anime Kai & Fan-Edits
description: Universal streaming & metadata synchronization plugin for Anime Fan-Edits and Encrypted Streams: Re:Zero Perfect Run, One Pace, Naruto Kai, Bleach Kai, and Consumet HLS Gateway.
overview: Universal Anime Fan-Edits & Direct HLS Stream Integration with Zero-Torrent Privacy Protection.
